record.scope: Smoke install of the source distribution: demo, report, summarize, the SQLite agent-loop example, migration of a trace written by 1.2.0, OpenTelemetry export/import and a composite verify from two readback files; not the full installed-artifact checker.

publication_boundary: Retained local publication/registry receipts report successful PyPI upload and installation. Archive sizes/hashes and wheel/source payload mapping checked independently here. No current PyPI response or live site/API was fetched, per no-network instruction.

research_impact.unchanged_refund_verifier: The entire RefundVerifier class AST and helper _peak_count are unchanged, though their module verification.py changed around dispatch/receipt validation.
research_impact.migration: All migration functions and class ASTs are unchanged; only module branding docstring changes. Re-derivation calls the changed public verify wrapper, so unchanged migration source alone is not a whole-pipeline equivalence proof.
research_impact.wrapper_changes: verify/averify accept one Observation or nonempty tuple/list; choose verify_readbacks/averify_readbacks when supported; validate distinct observation IDs and receipt evidence against supplied observations, with receipt time covering the maximum supplied observed_at_ms. For the old default single-observation refund path, static branch tracing reaches the same RefundVerifier.verify method and corresponding single-observation checks. This is static reasoning, not an additional 503-trace run.
research_impact.other_changes: Capture/readback polling can retain several observations. Reports/CLI add composite/OTel presentation and commands. Schema generator and bundled schema have display-title branding changes, with validation definitions unchanged. Errors/research/benchmark initializer changes are branding-only.
research_impact.paper_rule: Retain the 503-trace conformance source f64bf49 and 2.0.0 label; do not reclassify it as 2.1.1 validation. Exact module/function mapping supports a narrow static continuity statement, not end-to-end current-package equivalence. Any new claim of2.1.1 corpus conformance requires a separately pinned offline check.

new_feature_boundaries.composite: all_of/any_of combine part contracts, per-source observations, three-valued part verdicts, target IDs, provenance and findings; supports nesting/async. The two-part example is scripted offline SQLite with simulated time, not production payment/CRM integration or a new benchmark.
new_feature_boundaries.opentelemetry: OTLP/JSON export and payload-enabled import; execute_tool-span capture; optional API emission. Installed tests use OpenTelemetry API/SDK 1.45.1 and an in-memory exporter. No live collector or tracing backend exercised. Payload omission is not anonymization.
new_feature_boundaries.sdk_offline_checks: 37 installed-wheel tests, zero skipped/provider calls, actual SDK packages but scripted model/transport/tool loops: openai-agents 0.24.0, langchain-core 1.6.12, claude-agent-sdk 0.2.168. These are integration engineering checks.
new_feature_boundaries.sdk_live_checks: Three separate real-model smoke loops, one per SDK; OpenAI Agents and LangChain use local Ollama qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M, Claude Agent SDK uses Haiku through existing Claude Code login (remote inference). Each records one SQLite refund write followed by injected timeout, failure report, satisfied state/confirmed origin and contradicted alignment. Passed checks capture matching and absence of uncaught run error, not comparative model accuracy.
new_feature_boundaries.live_reproducibility_limits: Git release directory retains aggregate outputs but not pinned model digest/seed, provider-call counts/full provider transcript, or per-framework trace/database. One case/model/run per SDK; cost not established. No gain from retry advice or controller comparison follows.
new_feature_boundaries.mcp_wording_correction: Release README/checks say no MCP server was used, but scripts/check_live_integrations.py creates an in-process Claude SDK billing MCP server with create_sdk_mcp_server. Say no external/deployed MCP-service interoperability validation; do not claim no MCP server of any kind.
new_feature_boundaries.platforms: Installed core wheel checked on one Windows host with Python 3.11.9/3.12.10/3.13.16/3.14.8/3.15.0 plus one emulated Alpine 3.24.2/Python 3.14.8 guest. SDK extras/live runs were Windows 3.12 only; Linux checked core and missing-extra import behavior. macOS untested. New-interpreter full source suites at 4f2cf80 report one initial demo-data comparison failure each, attributed to concurrent regeneration, followed by passing reruns; do not report uniformly failure-free full suites at final release revision.
